{{Quote|There's a fantastic Mandalorian restaurant in Kaas City&mdash;I'm half-allergic to the dumplings, and I still love it.|Raina Temple|<ref>{{TORcite|type=conversation|Raina Temple|Music}}</ref>}}
A '''restaurant''' serving [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] cuisine was located in [[Kaas City]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]] during the reign of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. [[Raina Temple]] was a fan of the restaurant, though she was partially allergic to their dumplings.
